question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        e.event_type,
        p.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
views AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as view_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 1
    GROUP BY product_id
),
add_to_cart AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as add_to_cart_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 2
    GROUP BY product_id
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as purchase_count
    FROM product_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
    GROUP BY product_id
),
left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT pe.product_id, COUNT(*) as left_in_cart_count
    FROM product_events pe
    WHERE pe.event_type = 2
    AND pe.visit_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pe2.visit_id 
        FROM product_events pe2 
        WHERE pe2.event_type = 3 AND pe2.product_id = pe.product_id
    )
    GROUP BY pe.product_id
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(v.view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(a.add_to_cart_count, 0) AS add_to_cart_count,
    COALESCE(l.left_in_cart_count, 0) AS left_in_cart_count,
    COALESCE(p.purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
FROM views v
FULL OUTER JOIN add_to_cart a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN left_in_cart l ON v.product_id = l.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN purchases p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY product_id
